sermons.title: Let Scripture guide daily life
sermons.summary: The ministry’s Statement of Faith describes Scripture as nourishment, guidance and a mirror for believers. Its teaching connects belief with putting God’s Word into practice.
takeaways: Read Scripture for direction and reflection.

sermons.title: A life rooted in faith
sermons.summary: The Statement of Faith places Christ at the centre of the believer’s life. It points to the people of faith in Scripture as examples for believers today.
takeaways: Look to Christ as the foundation of faith.
Learn from the lives of faith recorded in Scripture.

sermons.title: Generosity that cares for others
sermons.summary: The Giving Ministry teaches that generosity is part of the church’s responsibility to people in need. Its published mission includes care for orphans, widows, disadvantaged children and university students.
takeaways: Give freely from what you have received.
